overall_status: partial - core workflows implemented; gaps listed explicitly

pages.My Account: Implemented using exposed account fields; Google link/unlink and password flow retained. Email/phone are not exposed by SelfUser; Reveal masks the real user ID instead.
pages.Profiles: Implemented: display name, avatar actions, banner presets, pronouns, 190-character about-me editor, live popout preview, real profile commands.
pages.Privacy & Safety: UI only. Global DM/friend-request privacy policies have no protocol fields/endpoints; controls are unavailable, not fake saves.
pages.Devices: Implemented against real session snapshots and logout commands, including all-other-device revocation.
pages.Notifications: Device-global defaults are persisted locally. Per-server modal writes real synced notification settings, suppression and timed mute. Native presentation/sounds remain platform integration work.
pages.Voice & Video: Requested placeholder layout/model implemented. Default-only device options and disabled mic test are intentional until the audio agent wires enumeration/test/engine behavior.
pages.Appearance: Implemented: Cozy/Compact and chat font scale apply to real chat layout, with shaped-layout invalidation.
pages.Accessibility: Partial: underline-links applies live; saturation is persisted but not applied to the shared global color tokens.
pages.Keybinds: Partial: list, key capture and persistence implemented; runtime/global shortcut dispatch remains main-window/audio integration work.
pages.Advanced: Developer-mode toggle implemented; Copy ID added to existing entity menus.
pages.Server Profile: Implemented: name/icon, ten gradient presets, 120-character description, sticky preview, dirty/reset/save bar and real mutations.
pages.Engagement: Not implemented: protocol has neither a system-messages channel field nor server-wide default-notification policy. Own notification settings are available separately.
pages.Members: Implemented role chips, role filtering and paged real member data.
pages.Roles: Implemented list/default permissions, create/edit/delete/reorder, hierarchy-aware controls, three editor tabs and role assignment/removal. Reorder uses complete canonical role IDs.
pages.Channel settings: Implemented name/topic plus real complete overwrite replacement, private toggle and role/member tri-states. Slowmode is explicitly later.
pages.Invites and Bans: Retained real commands and restyled, with populated and empty visual fixtures.
pages.Emoji / Access / Audit Log: Navigation exists; management pages are explanatory placeholders, not implemented backends.

known_visual_followups: Shared legacy tooltip styling still uses its existing radius/background and no arrow; full UI_PARITY global tooltip treatment remains to be reconciled with the parallel shared-UI work.
Shared modal backdrop remains the existing 70 percent token instead of the parity 60 percent value; kept unchanged to avoid editing parallel global theme behavior.
Role-list overflow deletion is an inline action; the role-editor overflow uses a floating menu. Shared-menu integration should unify list behavior and popup outside-click/arrow-key handling.
